subject: Web Development
title: AI-Powered Search and Discovery
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on AI-Powered Search and Discovery.

hook.text: Traditional search returns links. AI search returns answers synthesized from many sources.

buildup.text: ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews summarize information instead of listing pages.

discovery.text: Users get direct answers without clicking through multiple websites.

twist.text: Websites lose traffic when AI answers questions directly. The economics of content creation shift.

climax.text: AI search is rewriting the web's discovery model — and no one knows what comes next.

punchline.text: Answers replaced links as the search result.

quiz.question: How does AI search differ from traditional search?
options: It synthesizes answers instead of listing links
